queries: Alexa+ user study expectations capabilities satisfaction 2025 2026
Alexa+ expectations before after user study survey 2026 2025

sources_considered.why: Primary description of conversational Alexa+. The retrieved version explicitly identifies its July 2026 update.
Firsthand household experience provides a useful counterweight to assuming that broader capabilities necessarily disappoint users.
The study concerns perceptions of earlier Alexa, not expectation changes following Alexa+ adoption.
Search suggested relevant interview research, but read_page did not return the requested passages. Its applicability could not be verified.

evidence_items.locator: Introduction, paragraph beginning Conversations with Alexa+
evidence_items.explanation: Amazon describes an available assistant supporting broad, contextual conversation. This meets the ordinary reading of the antecedent, although the description is a company claim.

evidence_items.locator: Section Alexa+ Will Stick Around in My Smart Home, for Now
evidence_items.explanation: The reviewer reports successful conversations and home-control tasks alongside failures, and increased willingness to use Alexa. One household cannot establish the population-wide change in expectations or the proportion left unmet.

unresolved_gaps: No verified representative study measured expectations before and after conversational Alexa adoption.
No verified study established what proportion of expected capabilities Alexa could meet.
Usage and satisfaction reports do not identify the causal effect claimed.
